name: How much does it cost to install new flooring in a foreclosed house?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install new flooring in a foreclosed house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary widely depending on the chosen material, total square footage, and subfloor conditions. Foreclosed properties usually carry higher upfront labor costs than standard occupied homes because they often demand extensive tear-out, odor remediation, and leveling. Luxury vinyl plank remains on the budget-friendly end of the spectrum, while materials like solid hardwood or custom tile and marble carry higher labor and material investments. Getting an on-site evaluation allows us to assess the foundation, subfloor layers, and transition thresholds to give an accurate, itemized plan for the rehabilitation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on square footage, material selection, and required subfloor remediation. Foreclosed homes often need extra demo or leveling before installation begins.
